Incl

Incl (global inclusions ) groups empty elements which may appear at any point within a TEI text.
Member of classes (none)  
Members anchor editIncl [addSpan delSpan gap] figure metadata [alt altGrp certainty fLib fs fsLib fvLib index interp interpGrp join joinGrp link linkGrp respons span spanGrp timeline] refsys [cb fw lb milestone pb]

%m.metadata; | %m.refsys;">
